control-rfc9421-v1 request for the terminal page of a 101-record frozen snapshot at GET /control/v1/roster/snapshot?continuation_token=ARgYGBgYGBgYGBgYGBgYGBgAAAAAAAAACQAAAAAAAAABAAAAAAAAAGQcHBwcHBwcHBwcHBwcHBwcHBwcHBwcHBwcHBwcHBwcHA (tag rem-control-roster-snapshot-v1); generation 1 integration key. The token binds snapshot 0x18*16 at generation 9 to page 1 and record offset 100. Mutations are applied to the request as received with the original Signature and Signature-Input retained.

inputs.name: snapshot.prefix-reporter-id-derivation
inputs.value: For each integer 0 through 99 inclusive, encode it as exactly 32 unsigned big-endian bytes and then as canonical unpadded base64url. Substitute that value for <derived reporter_id> in the template and sort the 100 records by reporter_id. Append the expected response record as record 100.
